result.rationale: The plan includes several antibiotic recommendations (L011, L018‑L021) that are not backed by any of the supplied evidence passages (S009, S011, S012, S015, S016). The only passages that map to the plan are S015 (monitoring for at least 12 hours) and S009 (repeat CRP 18‑24 h and consider lumbar puncture), which are correctly cited for monitoring and CRP repeat. No passage provides guidance on specific antibiotic substitutions for penicillin allergy, so citations for those claims are missing or incorrect. Citation mapping is ambiguous because the plan does not link lines to specific citations, further reducing citation correctness and completeness.
